title: Community Soda Kiln Firing
source_quote: Upcoming Soda Kiln Firing Dates: April 14th May 13th June 17th
evidence_sentence: The studio offers community soda kiln firings on announced dates with costs and guidelines listed.
evidence_quote: The Clay Studio has a Bailey Pottery Soda Kiln (DLX 18-C) for community soda firings.
summary: The Clay Studio runs Bailey Pottery soda firings on dated days. Potters bring bisque-fired work (max 12" tall), use studio-provided glazes and wadding, and pay $75 per cubic foot of kiln space (max 2 shares per person). Studio techs load and fire; potters collect finished work during scheduled pickup times.
cost_text: $75.00 per 1 cubic foot of space, maximum 2 shares per person
bring: Bisque-fired work rated for cone 6 or higher, no larger than 12" tall or 12" wide
how_to_join: Sign up for a glazing time slot one week before loading date; notify studio one week before if you don't have enough work to fill your share
pay_text: $75 per cubic foot of space; cancellations more than 2 weeks prior get credit minus $25 fee
